page.title: What we offer
page.description: Every engagement is scoped around the outcome you need, handled discreetly and within Indian law.

items.title: Private Investigation
items.shortDescription: Discreet, evidence-based investigations for individuals and businesses.
items.description: Confidential investigative support covering matrimonial, personal and civil matters, carried out with legal compliance and strict client confidentiality.

items.title: Corporate Intelligence
items.shortDescription: Due diligence and risk intelligence for informed business decisions.
items.description: Data-driven due diligence, competitor intelligence and risk assessments that help businesses make informed, defensible decisions.

items.title: Background Verification
items.shortDescription: Thorough background checks for employment, tenancy and partnerships.
items.description: Verification of identity, address, employment history and criminal records for individuals and organisations before entering into an agreement.

items.title: Security Guard Services
items.shortDescription: Trained security personnel for residential and commercial properties.
items.description: Deployment of vetted, trained security guards and supervisors for residential societies, offices and events across West Bengal.

items.title: Home Security Consulting
items.shortDescription: Security audits and surveillance planning for homes and gated communities.
items.description: On-site security audits, CCTV and access-control planning, and gap analysis for homes and residential societies.

items.title: Surveillance & Monitoring
items.shortDescription: Covert and overt surveillance to gather verifiable evidence.
items.description: Trained field operatives conduct surveillance assignments to gather verifiable, court-admissible evidence where required.
